```{=html}
<style>
.w043 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w043 .w043-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w043 .w043-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w043 .w043-q { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w043 .w043-in {
  flex: 0 0 130px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  font-weight: 600; font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace, monospace); min-width: 0;
}
.w043 .w043-in.w043-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w043 .w043-in.w043-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w043 .w043-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w043 button.w043-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w043 .w043-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w043 .w043-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w043 .w043-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w043 .w043-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w043 .w043-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w043 iw" id="w043">
  <div class="w043-rows" aria-label="fill in the answers"></div>
  <div class="w043-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w043-btn w043-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w043-btn w043-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w043-btn w043-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w043-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w043-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w043-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    A web server listens on port 80 for plain HTTP and on 443 for HTTPS, SSH listens on 22, and <code>ss -tulpn</code> lists every port the machine listens on - each of which is a door and part of the attack surface, to be justified line by line. See <a href="#sec-04-addresses-ports-attack-surface">the section on addresses, ports and the attack surface</a> and <a href="#def-attacksurface">the definition of the attack surface</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w043');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w043-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w043-msg');
  // [question, checker, canonical answer to show]
  function isPort(n) { return v => v === n; }
  const QUESTIONS = [
    ['A web server listens for plain HTTP on port …', isPort('80'), '80'],
    ['A web server listens for HTTPS on port …', isPort('443'), '443'],
    ['SSH listens on port …', isPort('22'), '22'],
    ['Which command lists every port this machine listens on?',
      v => v === 'ss' || v.indexOf('ss ') === 0 || v.indexOf('ss-') === 0,
      'ss -tulpn']
  ];
  function norm(s) {
    s = s.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[.!]+$/, '').trim();
    s = s.replace(/^sudo\s+/, '');
    return s;
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w043-in').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w043-right', 'w043-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w043-msg iw-msg';
  }
  QUESTIONS.forEach((q, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w043-row';
    const lab = document.createElement('label');
    lab.className = 'w043-q'; lab.textContent = q[0]; lab.htmlFor = 'w043-in' + i;
    const inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.className = 'w043-in'; inp.type = 'text'; inp.id = 'w043-in' + i;
    inp.autocomplete = 'off'; inp.spellcheck = false;
    inp.dataset.k = i;
    inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
    row.appendChild(lab); row.appendChild(inp);
    rowsBox.appendChild(row);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w043-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, empty = 0;
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w043-in').forEach(inp => {
      inp.classList.remove('w043-right', 'w043-wrong');
      const v = norm(inp.value);
      if (!v) { empty++; return; }
      if (QUESTIONS[Number(inp.dataset.k)][1](v)) { inp.classList.add('w043-right'); right++; }
      else { inp.classList.add('w043-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === QUESTIONS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - every listening port is a door, and these are the named ones.'; msg.className = 'w043-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + empty + ' field(s) still empty.'; msg.className = 'w043-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - the red fields hold the wrong answer.'; msg.className = 'w043-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w043-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w043-in').forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w043-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w043-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w043-in').forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = QUESTIONS[Number(inp.dataset.k)][2];
      inp.classList.add('w043-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w043-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w043-expl').hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
